test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statement are given below, followed by four conclusions given in the options. Find out which conclusion is true based on the given statements.

**Statement:** M > N > O = P, Q < C = D < O
solution:
Given Statement: M > N > O = P, Q

Now,

Conclusions:

Option 1: Q → True (M > N > O = P, Q It gives M > Q)

Option 2: C > M → False (There is no information given about C in relation to M)

Option 3: P = Q → True (O = P, Q It gives P = Q)

Option 4: N → False (There is no information given about D in relation to N)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
